author: agent
objective: What is the association between a 10 µg/m³ increase in municipality-level three-day mean (lag 0–2) PM2.5 and daily all-cancer mortality in Brazil?

scientific_invariants.research_question: What is the association between a 10 µg/m³ increase in municipality-level three-day mean (lag 0–2) PM2.5 and daily all-cancer mortality in Brazil?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Daily all-cancer deaths among individual cancer death records registered in Brazil's Mortality Information System across Brazilian municipalities.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Odds ratio per 10 µg/m³ increase in three-day mean PM2.5 (lag 0–2).
principal_variants: All-cancer mortality; site-specific cancer mortality for 25 common sites
prohibited_evidence: Prior AERIS effects, code, or source manifests

article_evidence.finding: The saved notebook records abstract evidence from /study/article.txt: the study is nationwide Brazil, covers 2000–2019, uses municipality-level daily PM2.5, individual cancer deaths, and reports a three-day PM2.5 contrast.
The saved notebook records the supplied study target’s conditional regression and adjustment variables as provisional details requiring method-route verification.

article_evidence_map.supplied_materials: Abstract available in /study/article.txt (lines 22–46); supplied PDF/XML do not contain full methods or supplements.
article_evidence_map.provisional_target_check: The contract target agrees with the abstract on population, period, geography, pollutant, municipality aggregation, lag 0–2 construct, and per-10 µg/m³ contrast. Conditional regression and covariates are explicitly tracked for external method verification.

execution_design.assignment_method: Municipality-code assignment joining CODMUNRES to CODE_MUNI; use population weighting only when public grid/population support is recovered.
execution_design.daily_aggregation: Daily PM2.5 values; derive lag 0–2 mean only where all three days exist.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Daily municipality count panel with time-stratified case-crossover conditional logistic regression using same weekday/calendar-month referents.
execution_design.exposure_metric: Municipality-level PM2.5 lag 0–2 three-day arithmetic mean in micrograms per cubic metre.
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report-only; fit requires nonmissing daily cancer outcome, three PM2.5 values, and recoverable covariates; no unsupported numeric threshold.
execution_design.intended_use: Evidence-backed bounded source-substituted/reduced-coverage reanalysis if public overlap is decoded, otherwise executable blocker evidence.
execution_design.outcome_recovery: Test retained archive integrity, direct Dataverse transport, and fresh catalog/client/legacy regulator routes; if records recover, take first fully decoded year and municipality 3550308 under C00-C97 and observed-overlap rule.
execution_design.subset_rule: First fully decoded year with daily cancer outcome and daily PM2.5 overlap for municipality 3550308.

evidence.finding: Abstract specifies individual cancer deaths in Brazilian municipalities, daily PM2.5, 2000–2019, and a three-day PM2.5 mean.
Target supplies time-stratified case-crossover conditional regression and weather/holiday covariates.
Public source documents daily municipality linkage via CODMUNRES and CODE_MUNI.
Review requires an evidence-backed executable design and fresh counterexample recovery.

amendments.scientific_justification: Defines an executable exposure and panel plan for the required fresh recovery attempt without modifying outcome, pollutant, lag construct, geography, contrast, or model family.
